items.title: 68251_Teddy McRae oral history interview
items.q: That was the guy, the leader -- directing Chick's band.

ctx.x: And we were on our way in and we came in then. I was in town about two weeks and I was playing at the one of the bars at 141st and 7th Avenue, and Bardu Ali came on.
That was the guy, the leader -- directing Chick's band. "Hey, man, Chick told me you was back in town. Chick wanna see you.
I say, "Wanna see me?" He say, "Elmer Williams don't want to leave to go on the road." This is that hard year, '36 -- the summer of '36 -- April.
